name: EnemyDetectorOverlay
signature: uint32_t EnemyDetectorOverlay(int contextBase, int targetAddr, float sortingDistance, int configFlag, int *screenPosition, int eventParam, int extraParam1, int extraParam2)
note: Shows red box on enemy when using binoculars. Params: contextBase=AI/render base (e.g. 0x01A3F4C0), targetAddr=target address (e.g. 0x00472C50), sortingDistance=float (e.g. 12.5), configFlag=overlay type (e.g. 1), screenPosition=out vec2 ptr, eventParam/extraParam1/extraParam2=optional (0).
